units.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market
units.text: 1. Acts by an economic entity holding a dominant position in a product market, other than a natural monopoly entity, that constitute abuse of a dominant position and are prohibited by the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation, where those acts harm or may harm the interests of other persons but do not and cannot result in the prevention, restriction or elimination of competition, except in the cases provided for by Article 9.21 of this Code, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14.31

units.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market
units.text: 2. Acts by an economic entity holding a dominant position in a product market that constitute abuse of a dominant position and are prohibited by the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation, where those acts result or may result in the prevention, restriction or elimination of competition; or acts by a natural monopoly entity that constitute abuse of a dominant position and are prohibited by the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for by Article 9.21 of this Code, —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14.31

units.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, one hundredth to fifteen hundredths of the offender’s revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the administrative offence was committed, or of the offender’s expenditure on purchasing the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, but not more than one fiftieth of the offender’s total revenue from selling all goods (work or services) and not less than one hundred thousand roubles; where the revenue from selling those goods (work or services), or expenditure on purchasing them, exceeds 75 percent of the offender’s total revenue from selling all goods (work or services), or where the offence was committed in a market for goods (work or services) sold at prices (tariffs) regulated under the legislation of the Russian Federation, the fine shall be three thousandths to three hundredths of the offender’s revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, or of the expenditure on purchasing the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, but not more than one fiftieth of the offender’s total revenue from selling all goods (work or services) and not less than one hundred thousand roubles.

units.text: 4. For an administrative offence under this Article or Article 14.31.2, 14.32 or 14.33 of this Code, where there are no mitigating or aggravating circumstances, the administrative fine imposed on a legal entity shall be the sum of the minimum fine provided for that offence and half the difference between the maximum and minimum fines provided for that offence. Where the circumstances provided for by Clauses 5 and 6 of Part 1 of Article 4.2 of this Code are present, the fine imposed on a legal entity shall be the minimum fine provided for that offence.
